MetastasisSiteMention.description:
A single documented metastatic site (applies when there is metastasis, i.e. Chang
M2/M3/M4). Emit one per distinct site.

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

site.description: CSF: positive CSF/cytology. SPINE: spinal drop metastases. BRAIN: intracranial metastasis beyond primary. LEPTOMENINGEAL: leptomeningeal spread. BONE_MARROW: marrow involvement. KIDNEY / LIVER: named viscus. OTHER: another site. NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: no metastatic site documented.

site_date.description: Date this metastatic site was documented, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
site_date.title: Site Date

site_date_precision.description: Precision for site_date. Null when site_date is null.

has_mention.title: Has Mention

csf_collection_site.description: Lumbar, ventricular, or other site exactly as documented; null if unknown.
csf_collection_site.title: Csf Collection Site

csf_collection_date.description: CSF specimen collection date, not result-signoff date; ISO date at supported precision.
csf_collection_date.title: Csf Collection Date

csf_collection_date_precision.description: Precision of csf_collection_date; null when absent.

brain_mri_date.description: Brain metastatic assessment date, ISO date at supported precision.
brain_mri_date.title: Brain Mri Date

brain_mri_date_precision.description: Precision of brain_mri_date; null when absent.

spine_mri_date.description: Spine metastatic assessment date, ISO date at supported precision.
spine_mri_date.title: Spine Mri Date

spine_mri_date_precision.description: Precision of spine_mri_date; null when absent.

spine_mri_findings.description: Spine MRI for drop metastases / spinal leptomeningeal seeding. POSITIVE: seeding present. NEGATIVE: spine MRI done, no seeding. UNAVAILABLE: spine MRI not done or not reported.

brain_mri_findings.description: Brain MRI for intracranial metastasis/seeding beyond the primary. POSITIVE: intracranial seeding present. NEGATIVE: done, none. UNAVAILABLE: not done or not reported.

csf_cytology.description: CSF cytology; record lumbar versus ventricular source and collection date separately. POSITIVE: malignant cells present. NEGATIVE: cytology negative. UNAVAILABLE: not performed or not reported.

extraneural_metastasis.description: Metastasis outside the CNS (bone marrow, bone, viscera). POSITIVE: extraneural metastasis present. NEGATIVE: worked up, none. UNAVAILABLE: no extraneural workup or not reported.
